title: Longest Duplicate Substring Length
description: Given a lowercase string `s`, return the length of the longest contiguous substring that occurs at least twice in `s` (the occurrences may overlap). If all characters in `s` are distinct, return `0`.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: If a duplicated substring of length L exists, then duplicated substrings exist for every length < L—so binary search on L.
For a candidate length L, compute double rolling hashes for every window of length L and check for any hash collision in O(n) time.

examples.explanation: "ana" appears twice in "banana" (overlapping at indices 1 and 3), length 3.
All letters in "abcd" are distinct, so no duplicate substring exists (length 0).
